evidence.title: ⚽ Football Match Analyzer — Multi-Agent AI System

name: Football Match Analyzer
summary: Multi-agent AI system that turns football match video into performance analytics — player tracking, team classification and match reports.
description: Runs a broadcast match video through six agents orchestrated by LangGraph: YOLOv8s + ByteTrack detect and track players, KMeans classifies teams from jersey colors, rule-based logic finds passes, tackles and interceptions, and Groq's Llama 3.3 70B writes the match report. Videos go in through a Telegram bot and follow-up questions get answered in natural language; runs on a consumer GPU with a free-tier LLM.
contains: six agents orchestrated with LangGraph, driven by a Telegram bot
YOLOv8s + ByteTrack player detection and tracking; KMeans jersey-color team classification
event detection (passes, tackles, interceptions) and physical stats (distance, top speed, sprints, heatmaps)
Groq Llama 3.3 70B match reports and natural-language follow-up questions
per-video caching: about 2 minutes for 5000 frames on an RTX 2050; ~2K tokens per message
MIT, Python 3.12+; known limits: ball detection ~47% coverage, pixel units, one user at a time
